'''Gilatter''' was an undistinguished [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Star/Legends|star]] located within the [[Gilatter system/Legends|Gilatter system]],<ref name="Exile" /> a part of the [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Rago Run]], which connected it to the [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion]] and [[Sinton system/Legends|Sinton systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Gilatter was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by at least eight [[Planet/Legends|planets]],<ref name="CSWE" /> including the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Gilatter VIII]].<ref name="Exile" /> None of its worlds was habitable for most of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Exile" />

*''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]'' {{1st}}
